evalsTab.metricsSubtitle: Recall / Precision / Citation for this agent's eval cases
evalsTab.emptyCases: No eval cases yet. Create one to assert this agent's expected findings on a sample diff.
evalsTab.scoringNote: Scoring is mechanical — a finding counts when file matches and line ranges overlap. No model call in the scorer.
evalsTab.resultFailed: Last run did not pass · expected {expected}, got {actual}
evalsTab.deleteBody: {name} will be removed from this agent's case set.
evalsTab.deleteHistoryNote: Its recorded run history is deleted with it and cannot be restored.
evalsTab.metricsNeedSetRun: No metrics yet — these come from a run of the whole set. Running a single case does not produce them. Press “Run all evals”.
evalsTab.resultCountsNegative: {expected, plural, one {# forbidden location} other {# forbidden locations}} · {actual} findings produced · {verdict}

skillEvalsTab.resultLine: expected {expected, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}}, got {actual} · recall {recall} · With skill {withSkill} / Without skill {withoutSkill}
skillEvalsTab.twoSidedNote: A must-find case passes only when the finding appears WITH the skill and is absent WITHOUT it. A linked skill usually changes what a finding says rather than whether it is reported, so a red row reading 100% / 100% is the common outcome, not a broken harness.
skillEvalsTab.noAgentTitle: No enabled agent is linked to this skill
skillEvalsTab.noAgentBody: A skill case runs on the first enabled agent this skill is linked to, and there is none — link it to an enabled agent before running anything.
skillEvalsTab.emptyCases: No eval cases yet. Create one to check whether this skill changes what the agent finds.
skillEvalsTab.deleteBody: {name} will be removed from this skill's case set.
skillEvalsTab.deleteHistoryNote: Its recorded run history is deleted with it and cannot be restored.

reason.skill_caused: Found with the skill and absent without it — the skill caused this finding.
reason.found_without_skill: The agent found this without the skill, so the case demonstrates nothing about the skill.
reason.not_found_with_skill: The expected finding never appeared, even with the skill.
reason.forbidden_range_clean: The forbidden location stayed unflagged with the skill.
reason.forbidden_range_flagged: Something flagged the forbidden location in the run with the skill.
reason.no_without_result: The run without the skill produced no result, so there is nothing to compare.

compare.title: Compare runs · v{older} → v{newer}
compare.subtitle: Old prompt vs new — metric deltas and prompt diff on the {cases, plural, one {#-case} other {#-case}} set
compare.promoteDisabled: DevDigest has no promote-a-version concept — an agent has a single live prompt, edited in the agent editor.
compare.comparability: Both runs used the same case set and the same model, so the deltas are comparable — but model output varies between identical calls, so a small change is not proof of a regression.
